verdict.rationale: The only evidence of import/export is a community user who mentions teams exporting and importing JSON files to share collections, which implies the capability exists. First-party docs name a 'Postman Collection format' but never document import or export. missing for 10: first-party documentation of collection import/export, a list of supported portable formats (e.g., OpenAPI, cURL, HAR, other tools' formats), evidence of moving collections between tools, and independent corroboration beyond one passing remark.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import and export collections in portable formats to move between tools

citations.quote: without needing everyone to export/import JSON files
use types in collections to design your API with the Postman Collection format
